lessons.title: Designing Your Reconnaissance Scanner 🧠
lessons.description: Plan the architecture of a multi‑functional hacking tool that integrates port scanning, banner grabbing, and web recon.

lessons.title: Implementing the TCP Port Scanner Module 🔍
lessons.description: Write the core port scanning engine with threading for speed and robust error handling.

lessons.title: Adding Service Detection & Banner Grabbing 🏷️
lessons.description: Extend the scanner to identify services and grab banners, logging results to a file.

lessons.title: Web Recon Module: HTTP/HTTPS Probes 🌐
lessons.description: Fetch HTTP headers, page titles, and server info using `requests` and `BeautifulSoup`.

lessons.title: Assembling the Final Tool: CLI, Logging & Reports 📊
lessons.description: Combine all modules, add command‑line arguments, logging, and export results as CSV/JSON.
